summary: Peek accessor on a linked-list head: reads the first node pointer stored at (*this + 8), then returns a pointer to that node's data payload (first 4-byte field plus 4) when both the node pointer and its data pointer are non-null, otherwise returns 0. Used by FileEnumerationByExtension (00421B10) and sub_47BF30 (0047BF30) as a lite accessor for file/directory enumeration.

local_names.this: pointer to the list head structure
local_names.v2: data pointer stored in the first 4 bytes of the first node

operations.description: Load the first node pointer from offset 8 of the list head structure pointed to by this.
If the first node pointer is null (empty list), return 0.
Read the node's data pointer from the first 4 bytes of the node (the 4-byte node header).
If the node's data pointer is null, return 0.
Return data + 4, the pointer to the payload that follows the node's 4-byte header.
Called as a data-peek accessor by FileEnumerationByExtension (00421B10) and sub_47BF30 (0047BF30).

unresolved: The list head layout beyond offset 8 and the node layout beyond its first 4 bytes are not described by this function.
The exact node header semantics (why the payload starts at +4) are inferred from the return arithmetic only.
